messages:
jules: noticing a small but consistent uptick in SDK parse errors after yesterday's console rollout that enriches routing headers. stack traces show both Go and TS clients choking on unexpected header shapes.

maya: saw that too. Go SDK had a helper that json.Unmarshal's X-Redwood-Route if present; turns out some proxies are returning a url-encoded string instead of json.

tom: TS SDK defensively truncated long X-Route-Hash in v4.1.1 but didn't handle non-json payloads. suggests we need a negotiation handshake.

jules: recommendation: server should only emit verbose payloads when client advertises Accept-Route-Meta=1 during handshake. otherwise send compact token.

ci-bot: Created issue SDK-513: "Make SDKs tolerant to non-JSON routing headers and support Accept-Route-Meta negotiation". https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/513

maya: I'll cut a Go patch that tries json.Unmarshal but falls back to raw string on error and logs a structured warn. will add unit + e2e.

tom: I'll do the TS patch: treat header as optional, warn once per minute for malformed entries, and don't throw. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1020

deploy-bot: feature flag "route-enriched-payload" rollback requested for canary cohort. ETA ~3m.

jules: ops/console follow-ups: add header-size histogram and a negotiation flag (Accept-Route-Meta). ops: add alert if client panics > 0.05% over 5m.

tom: publishing patched TS v4.1.2 with tolerant parsing. linking changelog soon.

maya: Go v0.9.4 released with fallback parsing. drafting a short advisory for devex to notify customers about tolerant parsing and to recommend bumping SDKs.

jules: thanks all. we'll re-enable canary at 5% once we confirm no further panics. keeping thread open for ramp updates. :thumbsup:
